arn.text: Nailah, the Sorceress Queen of Rabiah, seduces the black Taysir and has him kill and absorb the green one, hoping the united Taysir will make her queen of all Rabiahs.
She uses the Ring of Ma'Ruf to find the Nomad Taysir, but the Apprentice rebels and attacks her, and she imprisons him in an oubliette.
Nailah tempts the Nomad to slay the Dervish, but he refuses and attacks her, and she then kills El-Hajjaj, who is revealed to be her father, and Raghib.
The Dervish merges with the Apprentice, becoming the complete Taysir, who blasts her and leaves, and Nailah bars him from returning to any plane of Rabiah.
